title: Just Vibecoded a browser MMORPG using GPT
author: Top-Assumption7555
selftext:
The entire code was made 100% using GPT codex 5.3 til now 5.5.

It's 100% javascript stack, node on server and vue + native HTML canvas on client.

I'm using the Tibia assets as placeholder for now, plan is replace it entirely later.

We reached peaks of 300 simultaneous players with stable latency in a 20$ VPS with 4gb ram and 2vpcu.

Post is awaiting moderator approval.

comments.author: Hocekklocek
comments.body: Whats different in your game to the real tibia?

replies.author: Top-Assumption7555
replies.body:
It's more like an idle experience pve inspired in private MU servers, and pvp/quests inspired in Tibia.


Also we have some unique systems and map.

replies.body: I assume it’s the game client. It’s the Pokemon battle theme where the hero has his back on the camera and is facing a demon on the other side.

comments.author: fued
comments.body: now vibe code the load balancing/testing and edge case network detection

replies.author: Top-Assumption7555
replies.body:
No load balancing needed, every server is a single node instance, with limited number of players, and the database is shared between all servers.


I'm using artillery to simulate performance with 500 players per server while my goal is keep it at 200.

replies.author: fued
replies.body: Oh so not an mmo an instanced rpg, that makes more sense

replies.author: Top-Assumption7555
replies.body: I thought about making a single unified world with clustered zones, but keeping multiple servers with a shared database solves the issue without requiring a massive map

comments.author: One_Enthusiasm9420
comments.body: I just played a while and im actually surprised. Why didnt you compete in vibe jam?

replies.author: Top-Assumption7555
replies.body: Never heard about one, but afaik in a jam you must create a project from scratch.

comments.author: Top-Assumption7555
comments.body:
Rebalanced combat to make progression clearer and more consistent. Character power now comes mainly from stats, with adjustments to attack, defense, critical hits, speed, runes, spells, and creatures.  
  
Basic attacks now scale better with Attack.  
Critical Chance now scales more directly with Luck.  
Agi now has a stronger impact on movement speed.  
Runes were adjusted to scale with Magic.  
Area spells and Knight healing spells were adjusted.  
Creature ranged attacks were strengthened.  
Early creature defense was reviewed.  
  
These changes should make combat more predictable, fair, and easier to balance going forward.
